title: Jackfruit
subtitle: A fruit tree. Grows wild in jungles.
text: Jackfruit hangs under the leaves like a cocoa pod. Break it when it is ripe for two, or early for one. Left alone, a ripe one drops its two after a few minutes and grows again. The leaves drop Jackfruit Saplings; plant one on grass or dirt and Bone Meal helps it grow.
